select a.name, a.app_id, DATE_FORMAT(b.binding_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS binding_time, b.openid_id, b.binding_state, a.bind_type, b.external_account from b_app a LEFT JOIN b_openid b ON b.app_id = a.app_id
b.user_id = #{listParam.userId} AND a.flag = 1 AND b.flag = 1

select `name`, app_id from b_app
app_id NOT IN ( SELECT app_id FROM b_openid WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND flag = 1 ) AND flag = 1

SELECT realname, mobile, o.user_id AS uid, o.flag, o.binding_state AS state, o.remark AS remark, o.app_id AS appid, bp.app_id AS proaid, bp.project_id AS pid, bp.NAME AS pname, o.openid_id AS oid, rop.flag AS rflag FROM b_openid o LEFT JOIN b_user b ON o.user_id = b.user_id LEFT JOIN r_openid_project rop ON rop.open_id = o.openid_id LEFT JOIN b_project bp ON bp.project_id = rop.project_id WHERE o.flag = 1
AND o.user_id IN
#{uid}
ORDER BY uid, appid, proaid

SELECT 1 FROM b_openid_share bos LEFT JOIN b_user u ON bos.user_id = u.user_id
share_openid_id in
#{id}
AND bos.flag = 1 AND u.flag = 1
and u.mobile = #{mobile}
and u.realname like CONCAT('%',#{name},'%')
GROUP BY bos.user_id
